headerDisplay:
Exposes Nest thermostats, Nest Protect smoke/CO alarms, and Nest Temperature Sensors in HomeKit. Signs in with a Google account that is an admin of the home.

How to copy the two sign-in values: [docs/AUTH.md](https://github.com/tbaur/homebridge-mynest/blob/main/docs/AUTH.md).
footerDisplay: Thermostat mode/setpoints/Eco write through Nest BatchUpdateState only when Allow thermostat control is enabled (off by default). Each thermostat gets an Eco Mode switch; optionally enable Expose global Eco switch for all-at-once. Protect occupancy is Nest's ~10-minute presence verdict (auto_away), not motion. Treat the Cookies like a password: they sign in to the whole Google account.

name.title: Name
name.description: Name shown in the Homebridge log.

issueToken.title: Issue Token URL
issueToken.description: The full URL of the issueToken request, copied from the browser's developer tools while signing in at home.nest.com. Starts with https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/iframerpc?action=issueToken.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.description: The Cookie request header of the oauth2/iframe request from the same sign-in. Gives access to the whole Google account, so use a dedicated account.

allowThermostatControl.title: Allow thermostat control
allowThermostatControl.description: Opt in to let HomeKit change thermostat mode, setpoints, and Eco via Nest BatchUpdateState. Off by default so upgrades stay read-only until you enable control. Nest publishes no supported write API, so leave this off unless you want HomeKit driving your HVAC.

exposeGlobalEcoSwitch.title: Expose global Eco switch
exposeGlobalEcoSwitch.description: Publish a Nest Eco Mode switch that turns Eco on or off for every thermostat at once. Writes still require Allow thermostat control.

exposeProtectOccupancy.title: Expose Protect occupancy
exposeProtectOccupancy.description: Publish an occupancy sensor when Nest auto_away is a boolean and the Protect is not reported as battery-powered. Unknown power does not hide a boolean Nest already sent. This is ~10-minute presence, not motion.

exposeProtectTemperature.title: Expose Protect temperature
exposeProtectTemperature.description: Publish temperature and humidity measured by each Nest Protect.

ignoredDeviceIds.title: Ignored device IDs
ignoredDeviceIds.description: Nest device IDs or serial numbers to leave out of HomeKit. IDs appear in the Homebridge log when devices are added.

fieldTest.title: Use Nest field-test servers
fieldTest.description: Point the plugin at home.ft.nest.com / grpc-web.ft.nest.com. Leave off unless you were told otherwise.

diagnosticsInterval.title: Diagnostics interval (seconds)
diagnosticsInterval.description: Seconds between health heartbeats in the Homebridge log. 0 disables (default). Allowed range 0–86400 (24h); values 1–29 are raised to 30.

structuredLogs.title: Structured diagnostic logs
structuredLogs.description: When diagnostics are enabled, also emit a machine-readable JSON line alongside each human-readable health report.

pagerdutySignals.title: Send Signals to PagerDuty
pagerdutySignals.description: Write this plugin's alert conditions to homebridge-pagerduty's signal store. Then allow homebridge-mynest to page in homebridge-pagerduty's settings. Needs Node 22.13 or later.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Emit verbose diagnostics. Credentials are redacted, but review any log before sharing it publicly.
